title: 🎨 Palette: Fix terminal residue cleanup for NO_COLOR environments
head: jules-12988657735329617174-c85629af
body:
💡 What: Detached the terminal line clearance logic (`\r\033[K`) from the `USE_COLORS` configuration flag, relying strictly on `sys.stderr.isatty()` instead. Refactored the inline clearance logic scattered across exception handlers to use the single `_clear_current_line()` helper function.

🎯 Why: When global color output is disabled (e.g., via `NO_COLOR=1`), hitting `Ctrl+C` during an interactive session leaves ugly `^C` ghost characters on the terminal line. The terminal clearance sequence works independently of color configurations and should be executed whenever running in an interactive TTY.

📸 Before/After: Visual ghost characters (`^C`) no longer linger on the screen when canceling prompts in uncolored mode.

♿ Accessibility: Improves the clarity and cleanliness of the CLI fallback mode.
